messages:
Jamal (AM): Heads up: MeridianTrust is evaluating Redwood to replace NovaServe. They asked for a short POC covering prompt parity, cost comparison, SSO + KMS, and an enterprise security checklist. Can we map out owners and immediate blockers?
Hiro (Sales Eng): Quick take: we need canonical request/response pairs from them, sample traffic distribution (seq lengths), and whether they use any vendor-specific post-processing (e.g., trimming or blacklisting). I can lead cost modeling and contract Qs.
Lina (SE): For parity testing I'll need: tokenizer dumps (input/output), the NovaServe max-length/truncation policy, and any stop-token list. Also want a small set (~200) of golden prompts. I can build a diff harness that computes BLEU/EM and embedding similarity.
Dana (Infra): Ops notes: MeridianTrust requires static egress IPs for their firewall, and a maintenance window constraint (no cutover during 02:00-06:00 local). They prefer Dedicated or Private for data residency. If Dedicated, need booking lead time ~2 weeks.
sec-bot: Security checklist flags: "customer-managed KMS?" -> supported (bring-your-own KMS). "Data residency?" -> Private/On-prem available. "Pen test schedule?" -> quarterly; customer can request SOC2 artifacts.
Jamal (AM): Pricing ask: NovaServe charges per token with a weird rounding rule (they round up partial tokens per 16-token block). They want to know expected monthly delta for 5M tokens/mo baseline. Hiro, can you approximate?
Hiro (Sales Eng): Yes. Approach: simulate tokenization differences on sample set and apply per-unit rates. Simple formula I'll provide in spreadsheet. Note rounding differences can add ~2-6% overhead depending on average token length.
Lina (SE): Acceptance criteria suggestion: (a) >=90% of prompts have top-1 semantic similarity >=0.85; (b) no more than 1% of responses contain unexpected tokenization artifacts (e.g., broken unicode); (c) 95th perc latency < 400ms on Dedicated for their median seq length.
Dana (Infra): Cutover plan: parallel routing for 48 hours (traffic split 80/20 -> 50/50 -> 0/100), health-check-based promotion, and automatic fallback to NovaServe if error rate >2.5% or avg latency >1s. Need a short runbook for routing flips.
Jamal (AM): Who drafts the security questionnaire responses? We should use the /sales/presales/security-templates but update KMS, IP allowlist, and logging retention.
sec-bot: Template location: /sales/presales/security-templates/sq-master.md. Note: update sections S3 (KMS) and L1 (logs).
Hiro (Sales Eng): I'll update billing spreadsheet and start SQ answers for finance/legal items. Lina, can you own the parity harness and run an initial smoke tomorrow?
Lina (SE): Yes. I'll push a small repo with scripts: tokenize_then_compare.py and a README. Plan: smoke run tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Dana (Infra): I'll prepare the CIDR list and Dedicated capacity estimate. Also will draft a 2-page rollback playbook for legal.
Jamal (AM): Great. Owners recap: Hiro=billing+sq-draft, Lina=parity harness+smoke, Dana=infra+runbook, Jamal=customer coordination. Everyone ok to deliver first drafts by EOD Thursday?
Hiro (Sales Eng): Yep. Spreadsheet + SQ by Thursday EOD.
Lina (SE): Thursday EOD works; will include example diffs and a short notes doc on mitigation strategies (reranker, token mapping).
Dana (Infra): On track. I'll include maintenance window constraints in the runbook.
Jamal (AM): If parity shows consistent deltas we may propose two mitigations: 1) prompt engineering / normalization layer; 2) reranker post-process to pick best match. We'll note cost tradeoffs. I'll book alignment call with MeridianTrust after the smoke.
